Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 58, "heading": "I\nLE PETIT SOULIER", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u058-b0158", "target": "Командир сделал разочарованную гримасу.", "source_sha256": "49bf06b460df4a9190a74179dec69d506e56330b899b12afcb074d6c563c1287", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u058-b0158", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f4ca027e14011ec1af5aee8e975d7890fad900ab1b89cb348aed2ce5d5e37083"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u058-b0159", "target": "«Не вздумай мне лгать, старый призрак, — продолжал он. — Меня зовут Тристан Лермит, и я кум короля. Тристан Лермит, слышишь?» Он добавил, окинув взглядом Гревскую площадь вокруг себя: «Это имя здесь отдаётся эхом.", "source_sha256": "6e3f78f6099fd4c27a5686dc28a5b71e8114a38a9ba9c855c81d6f9235816fb8", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u058-b0159", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7ed2c8167ac4c9411e12e2fec9d08b29f941438cabb56ac62c14e63edc75e0a1"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 11, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u058-b0160", "text": "—Vous seriez Satan l'Hermite, répliqua Gudule qui reprenait espoir, que je n'aurais pas autre chose à vous dire et que je n'aurais pas peur de vous.", "sha256": "7c9feb30a8214f4f8f8dfc3c187fccfdc554ff47255847e341b19a45261a8f11", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3807], "source_xml_sha256": "b17b4b28c20146f62fcd1d27fac61e8603f13ac50a2bb9b1d6cf3666a0d4e746", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0161", "text": "—Tête-Dieu! dit Tristan, voilà une commère! Ah! la fille sorcière s'est sauvée! et par où a-t-elle pris?»", "sha256": "a080ee88aee45d5a67bb85fdbfa2ce8b45a679a7b4d8b904f073eaf85242f8de", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3808], "source_xml_sha256": "7c87245008aef33202a21016bb0e17f3f55b3ab0becab666bf9199d94e53f7ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0162", "text": "Gudule répondit d'un ton insouciant:", "sha256": "31e9352cac7c95f40d748324a1232b0395c0a71f0228f584f973d0a93588ae62", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3809], "source_xml_sha256": "c6b87680fb3e69408f57b9d9ca23e05160883ff5be1a225f4230c23b7eef59d4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0163", "text": "«Par la rue du Mouton, je crois.»", "sha256": "3493590a2b3d29dfacdc6fe238e651272032758b1754075397049c4ccafc4ec4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3810], "source_xml_sha256": "25c89aa840a09e7c8d9ad3321ce93c42341158797a67962d0202d5dcb3ad19f3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0164", "text": "Tristan tourna la tête, et fit signe à sa troupe de se préparer à se remettre en marche. La recluse respira.", "sha256": "2de5c30918724c0bd0fe5645613df9e37c0c8611193c9eb076eaa16d6af248ff", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3811], "source_xml_sha256": "90b0a83d7b9956ddafed2b8edee4f8ece2d9adf4caf75f5525943377e6d736c2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0165", "text": "«Monseigneur, dit tout à coup un archer, demandez donc à la vieille fée pourquoi les barreaux de sa lucarne sont défaits de la sorte.»", "sha256": "22826bbd53a57b6af3550d62439bccaf699856b9172f8f18a7b4168e432c8259", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3812], "source_xml_sha256": "d3acc4e43ee460d730918b172d934da458b368e5bdc9b4427865194860c7269b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0166", "text": "Cette question fit rentrer l'angoisse au cœur de la misérable mère. Elle ne perdit pourtant pas toute présence d'esprit. «Ils ont toujours été ainsi, bégaya-t-elle.", "sha256": "9a50ba68ea3e3788444367f8fb56a14b0e2ad418046ef7c475440789fddc6b8f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3813], "source_xml_sha256": "f9902506fc3216abeac13bf60ee5441e8dca04b6ac5240ceaec84a7b72d1fbee", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0167", "text": "—Bah! repartir l'archer, hier encore ils faisaient une belle croix noire qui donnait de la dévotion.»", "sha256": "de04e85906539cd8e79cfae20a43305d248883943f38eeeef9b645020838797e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3814], "source_xml_sha256": "69811a06025e3cfb1c78b2895aac3d02b20e309a9807f9ea7b07b7bdfa208554", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0168", "text": "Tristan jeta un regard oblique à la recluse.", "sha256": "edc11282f62bdf7b19062e448d3ea0ad5981ae48e75bc387a8c416dd25f21a6a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3815], "source_xml_sha256": "97f09a434a836416e6269e146f05afe7e62c8fd846ba7d510b074e9c4b2eaec4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0169", "text": "«Je crois que la commère se trouble!»", "sha256": "29e7fa1d310068a8d41bc0cbf3a791d788db978de6e6ab76433024a442243344", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3816], "source_xml_sha256": "56a892b8296c9393046c5a44121d82f4af68e3c7e5505ca36b1fb21cb61ba249", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0170", "text": "L'infortunée sentit que tout dépendait de sa bonne contenance, et la mort dans l'âme elle se mit à ricaner. Les mères ont de ces forces-là.", "sha256": "71a7d40d799d99d45d94808ff00cea3216ac06ce4bb0c403aede03279f44643d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3817], "source_xml_sha256": "0e72895bd6229b0d22e6646a421bcad3b18d7770b9e972da2a82ef68999f7e04", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0171", "text": "«Bah! dit-elle, cet homme est ivre. Il y a plus d'un an que le cul d'une charrette de pierres a donné dans ma lucarne et en a défoncé la grille. Que même j'ai injurié le charretier!", "sha256": "5fc8384581f828c2203d6c88e1d6aea71e72a0606499375eade92b30108ace94", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3818], "source_xml_sha256": "f1fa40aff6212a7077e0dd11d4a8cd91e21aba53070443ef79d9d0e67e3f8e11", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0172", "text": "—C'est vrai, dit un autre archer, j'y étais.»", "sha256": "853394131baacfb078150d81c1b2b03587817b6c26e68a460ffeca1a7b0773d8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3819], "source_xml_sha256": "4d6abd8f03ac85f8408f203fa22a24b37fee2a205c0b42dc4eaf1e4fb571b144", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0173", "text": "Il se trouve toujours partout des gens qui ont tout vu. Ce témoignage inespéré de l'archer ranima la recluse, à qui cet interrogatoire faisait traverser un abîme sur le tranchant d'un couteau.", "sha256": "a551ebe92675f6b5a0f19576bebbf76077e7592e55d4a7122b42c2ee8fe2f05a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3820], "source_xml_sha256": "ff121ae0f82c01c5202557aa009784e3bc0c8c82f2229b17be05c4073d1c8f2a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0174", "text": "Mais elle était condamnée à une alternative continuelle d'espérance et d'alarme.", "sha256": "f91db13786ccbef919e5609cbb269229da9fe3b355ca4ffdf73983f5abf79a79", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3821], "source_xml_sha256": "797f5ee300770414a5cfbb17f34d3dadea36fffd42cf7da2d800b6df238f3372", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0175", "text": "«Si c'est une charrette qui a fait cela, repartit le premier soldat, les tronçons des barres devraient être repoussés en dedans, tandis qu'ils sont ramenés en dehors.", "sha256": "b749e56aa6541b52df83c4540f287cb5b18f08db113db82fcaa9b2b7bd7851cf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3822], "source_xml_sha256": "04efe10f10f0c02f1b76d0b35531291da750461f7dc53b227d74af79cb32eaeb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0176", "text": "—Hé! hé! dit Tristan au soldat, tu as un nez d'enquêteur au Châtelet. Répondez à ce qu'il dit, la vieille!", "sha256": "e59b8073b097ee03752232c76326ce6ec1eee96e72bcb798b4720b4486315c9f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3823], "source_xml_sha256": "234ba91e121768ab51a3d026657acaa49e56e8378d40d0cc5f34c01f8c55df81", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0177", "text": "—Mon Dieu! s'écria-t-elle aux abois et d'une voix malgré elle pleine de larmes, je vous jure, monseigneur, que c'est une charrette qui a brisé ces barreaux. Vous entendez que cet homme l'a vu. Et puis, qu'est-ce que cela fait pour votre égyptienne?", "sha256": "fc6c703bf60079b468eb854d1998de54b6fab81af2cc1d4e3280d5c43dbeed38", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3824], "source_xml_sha256": "a5e78db51b73420f8b97bf81a0012c7243a7ef556461daf9e6925f4317996e13", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0178", "text": "—Hum! grommela Tristan.", "sha256": "b260c62ecde83f8c85aa399b5759d5a60a75160b19c22656ec057595b4a21ec0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3825], "source_xml_sha256": "ec4045778fdc7a8ff46c9c625e373c0862c008a4a2c76cd055f26048911bec2a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0179", "text": "—Diable! reprit le soldat flatté de l'éloge du prévôt, les cassures du fer sont toutes fraîches!»", "sha256": "85a6db1c5c4ec850a1a479e4e59225c2bc1d9b4c093964dde431f38ccc572dac", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3826], "source_xml_sha256": "429ee346c5de08f2348b7672e619cc548ed36a190d8bff01d56233276e55cb35", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0180", "text": "Tristan hocha la tête. Elle pâlit. «Combien y a-t-il de temps, dites-vous, de cette charrette?", "sha256": "55a425423dec04bef930e61dcb433cc32990e216a9b53f7ce4fa458d2b77e5d5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3827], "source_xml_sha256": "6bc0f589b3b78bbd5937c1afc5a44392db9bbe0bb22ee8d505bbac5a23ed759d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0181", "text": "—Un mois, quinze jours peut-être, monseigneur. Je ne sais plus, moi.", "sha256": "afdcdb4b26b112dce0193657e2355a80fbdb2f9f3d2aeb98e45c22d1c261b1f4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3828], "source_xml_sha256": "55c30db1bcefac8ac915b1d51441f427ff7490420d5ee5abe8fd2462618cff06", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0182", "text": "—Elle a d'abord dit plus d'un an, observa le soldat.", "sha256": "372a72319c115eea10281672557fdf6b922d47bf8bc80f24c2d324037375f546", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3829], "source_xml_sha256": "4c8d87129219e67140a99d0ba6744e52c547beb217226eb80d1d05750eef6c78", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0183", "text": "—Voilà qui est louche! dit le prévôt.", "sha256": "80f422247c9bfb7d70aa2dc8e0eafec07fdd17d7dfa2f3caf5bd722833a18d08", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3830], "source_xml_sha256": "8e2c4f086eaf55664f2cc683be7e33fc4655181bd37a70dd44a2210b363e8221", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0184", "text": "—Monseigneur, cria-t-elle toujours collée devant la lucarne, et tremblant que le soupçon ne les poussât à y passer la tête et à regarder dans la cellule, monseigneur, je vous jure que c'est une charrette qui a brisé cette grille. Je vous le jure par les saints anges du paradis. Si ce n'est pas une charrette, je veux être éternellement damnée et je renie Dieu!", "sha256": "6b0218483051f102dbe2865bf4b31992cfcdf1e1208f77198337a08d9f12bcd0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3831], "source_xml_sha256": "9fdcfa40a5250b2d5e9f8f29b31d68c0974fbc207c82653bd923323c51c4d166", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0185", "text": "—Tu mets bien de la chaleur à ce jurement!» dit Tristan avec son coup d'œil d'inquisiteur.", "sha256": "88508e58288283c19e1a25b6eb6d41f36339bc00c9d1cbf7dd0c2a9d25290b98", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3832], "source_xml_sha256": "5851f75defb5a6aebf4041c3fe5f5bbcc79f5b12595feefb43da352e8c010a51", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0186", "text": "La pauvre femme sentait s'évanouir de plus en plus son assurance. Elle en était à faire des maladresses, et elle comprenait avec terreur qu'elle ne disait pas ce qu'il aurait fallu dire.", "sha256": "688e3180b98f487728b1d100e26f525283642e35f5f175aa9707fb3313330669", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3833], "source_xml_sha256": "9e91d256b2d090a712882d7eb1874e7ba919eed7ec1979938f87208ccbc60c44", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0187", "text": "Ici, un autre soldat arriva en criant: «Monseigneur, la vieille fée ment. La sorcière ne s'est pas sauvée par la rue Mouton. La chaîne de la rue est restée tendue toute la nuit, et le garde-chaîne n'a vu passer personne.»", "sha256": "2717b9fae69200f0f5c61fcc1d882122c0cf56f1cceb00fb3d3238fa0705d052", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3834], "source_xml_sha256": "0ca293d08796194bbd9ba1238fe31b9e059e5e33baa8eb6bc8b9cd5561f3ddcf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0188", "text": "Tristan, dont la physionomie devenait à chaque instant plus sinistre, interpella la recluse: «Qu'as-tu à dire à cela?»", "sha256": "357be2fd4b2bc821b6acfeda917e1d950812e69be4fc08b350f0dfdd28016af2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3835], "source_xml_sha256": "105cb1f848a623939b7fbd35823be47076166769130f47fec3e88512f756f189", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0189", "text": "Elle essaya encore de faire tête à ce nouvel incident: «Que je ne sais, monseigneur, que j'ai pu me tromper. Je crois qu'elle a passé l'eau en effet.", "sha256": "a39e23b1ffbb1e3dc82ca2ef28ff52ec7f7ed9f8f23409b99bc055148465193f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3836], "source_xml_sha256": "c85f2ce19ed380e4d280a5f30a53f6551feae05b8578e452c272b5bb04902f54", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0190", "text": "—C'est le côté opposé, dit le prévôt. Il n'y a pourtant pas grande apparence qu'elle ait voulu rentrer dans la Cité où on la poursuivait.
